newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PM MAY FIND NOBODY HOME ON KREMLIN VISIT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PM MAY FIND NOBODY HOME ON KREMLIN VISIT.

text.p: Finnish authorities said on Tuesday they were unaware of any plan by Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin to visit Slovakia just as his Finnish counterpart is due to meet him in Moscow.
Chernomyrdin's office meanwhile confirmed that he is due to visit Slovakia on April 28 to 29 -- the same dates as Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen plans to fly to Moscow at Chernomyrdin's invitation.
"We've heard nothing about any change of plan," said Lipponen's adviser Alec Aalto who is preparing the trip.
